originality.rationale: Original contribution is the sharp injectivity horizon and uniqueness of first predecessor for every prime-power modulus; least-modulus discriminator results have different quantifiers. Primary relevant papers were inspected in full, and six direct semantic searches of published published-finding corpus records returned no implication-equivalent result. Historical unlocated literature is a residual risk, not a demonstration of originality.
residual_risks: A more general or older unindexed source on collisions of quadratic polynomial residues might subsume this formula.
The reviewed three primary papers were not a systematic exhaustive search of all historical polynomial-discriminator literature.
The finite verifier cannot prove historical novelty or the universal mathematical claim.

value.rationale: A complete natural prime-power injectivity classification for the sequence in a published quadratic discriminator problem, with exact first-collision witnesses, uniqueness and an exponent-parity phase change. It supplies the missing fixed-modulus side of the classical least-modulus problem for infinitely many unbounded moduli, beyond a routine finite lookup or an isolated numeric improvement.
